W.note: Tight four-column card grid with a clear add-to-bag and stepper, but the desktop stepper label wraps to two lines and several product names are truncated.

X.note: The most complete shop (search, filters, sort, cart drawer with shipping progress and checkout), but it is large for a compact component, uses generic placeholder glyphs, and on mobile the header has no side gutter and the Cart button is clipped at the right edge.

Y.note: The densest and most restrained option, with clear price, add and stepper states, a sold-out state, and a live status line, though it has no cart drawer and some names truncate.

Z.note: Gradient swatches and a full cart drawer look current, but the badge text inherits a 64px swatch rule so it renders as a large white blob over each product, and the mobile header also loses its gutter.
